blocks.text: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) partner integrations enable you to use user-defined tags and resource attributes in Zscaler security policies. To fetch this information from the GCP tenant and projects, you must provide a service principal. Zscaler configuration requires a service account called a GCP account, which maps to service principal credentials that have access to a set of subscriptions in the same tenant.
Partner integrations provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Configure permissions for the Zscaler service to discover workloads and associated metadata from a set of GCP projects.
View discovered workloads and the associated metadata.
Associate a Cloud Connector with the workload information to enforce Zscaler security policies.

blocks.text: On the GCP page (Zero Trust Cloud > Common Resources > GCP), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of all accounts. For each account, you can view:
Name: The name of the account. Select a name to view the dashboard of account details.
Regions: The number of regions in the account.
Project List: The number of GCP projects in the account.
Cloud Connectors: The number of Cloud Connectors in the account.
Last Modified By: The last admin to modify the account.
Last Modified On: The date and time when the account was last modified.
Modify the table and its columns.
Go to the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Accounts page.
Go to the Microsoft Azure page.
